changes_from_v1: A1: n_usable_dates_to_origin counts every usable date <= origin (D-41), including the partial first week 2024-02-03/04 that v1 skipped; weekly cells still use complete weeks only

A2: records identical in all 11 source fields as text (string- vs number-typed JSON copies from the feed) are type_variant_duplicate: the string-typed copy is kept, the other excluded, before R03; they were mislabelled key_conflict in v1

B1 (D-56): adds the accepted increment stages after S3 (S4: 2026-10-21 .. 2026-10-25), fetched and accepted with the S1-S3 rule into their own manifest; weekly cells extend to the last complete week. No rule, threshold, identity or grade decision changed. Late-arriving records are not back-filled into held days (revision_log.csv)
